item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. We should take that prospect seriously now—before we build systems whose aims are beyond our control.

2. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. The choices we make now will shape whether we’re ready for that future.

3. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. We need clear-eyed public debate and serious preparation before that future arrives.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We are approaching a moment that demands honesty about what we are building. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. That is not a distant abstraction or a concern we can set aside until the technology arrives. It is a challenge we must face while decisions are still being made: how these systems are developed, who has power over them, and whether our institutions can respond. We are committed to bringing this risk into public conversation and urging serious preparation. The future is not something we can leave to chance. We must act with clarity, responsibility, and urgency now.
